name: cover
description: The money shot: a stolen coupe on the Avenida Sol at golden hour, traffic and pedestrians around it, the HUD with money and minimap, and the downtown skyline closing the boulevard.

name: chase
description: Three police cruisers behind the player's coupe, three wanted stars lit, the minimap showing the pursuit and the cruiser lights strobing on the Avenida Sol.

name: mission
description: A live harbour mission: the objective card and clock on the HUD, the mission beacon at the warehouse gate and the map diamond, with the player on foot on the quay.

name: night
description: The Neon Strip after dark: lit windows, blade signs, streetlight pools, a coupe and pedestrians on the lit pavement, and a HUD that stays readable at night.
